args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** with an elevated error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed rolled out successfully.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so no approval was needed for this rollback (it's a rollback to a previously healthy version, not a new deploy).
